queries.query: 我 plan mode 剛想好一個重構計畫，但還很粗。幫我把它變成一個可以自動跑的 goal。
這個計畫你幫我補完，然後讓它自己跑完，不要中途一直問我。
Turn this plan into a /goal I can kick off and walk away from.
Plan mode is done. What's next — how do I get the agent to actually execute all of this on its own?
I want to run this migration plan unattended overnight. Give me something with clear completion criteria so it doesn't drift.
幫我想一個把 auth 從 session 換成 JWT 的計畫，還沒有計畫，從頭規劃。
queries.note: Writing the plan itself is plan mode's job; this skill starts from an existing plan.

queries.query: 幫我把這個一行 typo 修好就好。
queries.note: A goal spec is overhead for a one-line fix.

queries.query: 把這份專案規劃寫成正式的簽呈給主管核可。
queries.note: Formal internal business document — formal-doc-structure's job, no autonomous execution involved.

queries.query: 這個計畫的第三步為什麼要先做 migration？跟我解釋一下。
queries.note: User wants an explanation of an existing plan, not a goal spec for running it.

queries.query: Set up a cron job that runs the test suite every morning and posts failures to Slack.
queries.note: Scheduling an existing command, not converting a rough plan into a bounded goal.
